alpha_definitions_as_implemented.a5_per_pair_day_normalized_v1: family1 (FXFV3-A5-P1). Proposal field VERBATIM: research/proposals/forex_free_v3/a5_lane/proposal_1.json incremental_test.operationalization = 'overall incremental alpha := (full-sample sum of the anchor's after-cost financing-adjusted per-pair-day PnL) - (same for the benchmark), both normalized per pair-day of the identical post-warmup schedule window, with identical notional units per active position. Gate: > 0. The per-trade expectancy difference (anchor - benchmark) is reported alongside as a diagnostic, not the gate.' Implemented in scored_runner.compute_cell exactly as: round((fsum(anchor scored financing-adjusted pnls) - fsum(benchmark scored financing-adjusted pnls)) / post_warmup_pair_days(price_source, meta.warmup_daily_bars), 10); the identical-notional condition holds because both books book through the same kernel at the same frozen 10000 USD-unit notional; the identical window is the snapshot's daily 16:00-NY decision calendar after the anchor's 63-bar warmup (the deeper of the two warmups, so it is the common post-warmup window for anchor and benchmark alike).
alpha_definitions_as_implemented.per_trade_expectancy_difference_v1: family2 (FXFV3-A6-P1). The a6 proposal's frozen gate: anchor financing-adjusted expectancy minus benchmark financing-adjusted expectancy -- byte-equivalent to the formula implemented before this lane; reported unchanged, with the same value now also carried as the diagnostic field on every scored anchor.
